title: MCvote
description: A plugin to add polls, quick polls (60 seconds) and voting with GUI voting.
body:
This plugin adds poll + vote functionality
- /polls : Opens GUI of all votes with the option to vote yes or no (for quickpolls) and the custom options (for regular polls)
- /poll create <question> [option1, option2, etc] <Seconds> : makes a poll for <seconds> seconds (time)
- /quickpoll <question> : makes a Yes or No poll for 60 seconds
- /vote [yes│no│customoption]
